findings.title: Splunk Security Advisory SVD-2026-1011 - Security Hardening in Splunk SOAR (October 2026)
findings.summary_md: Splunk published advisory SVD-2026-1011 on 2026-10-21 for Splunk SOAR version 8.7.0. The advisory groups multiple internally identified vulnerabilities with one CVE per CWE category; CVE-2026-76531 (CWE-552, CVSS 9.9) covers files or directories accessible to external parties. Upgrade to Splunk SOAR 8.7.0 or higher.

findings.title: Splunk Security Advisory SVD-2026-1001 - Splunk Enterprise Vulnerabilities (October 2026)
findings.summary_md: Splunk published advisory SVD-2026-1001 on 2026-10-21 addressing multiple vulnerabilities in Splunk Enterprise versions 10.4.3, 10.2.7, 10.0.10, and 9.4.15. Notable entries include CVE-2026-76299 (improper access control, CVSS 9.9) and CVE-2026-76302 (improper neutralization, CVSS 9.9). The advisory includes per-CVE remediation notes and acknowledgments to researchers including Gabriel Nitu.

findings.title: SecurityOnline.info - Splunk fixes 31 vulnerabilities including CVSS 9.9 flaws
findings.summary_md: SecurityOnline.info reported on 2026-10-22 that Splunk fixed 31 vulnerabilities across Enterprise and SOAR, naming the three CVSS 9.9 flaws CVE-2026-76531, CVE-2026-76299, and CVE-2026-76302. The article links to the Splunk advisory pages but does not extend beyond the headline counts. This is the source event from which the story was queued.
